toegepas.blok: Die Aarde draai om sy as
toegepas.voor: lyn deur die Aarde se middel wat niemand kan sien of aanraak nie
toegepas.na: lyn deur die Aarde se middel. Niemand kan dit sien of aanraak nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: The relative clause 'wat niemand kan sien' attaches to 'middel' rather than to 'lyn'; splitting the sentence makes clear it is the axis nobody can see, as the glossary says.
toegepas.fout: The relative clause 'wat niemand kan sien of aanraak nie' can attach to 'middel' instead of 'lyn'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Splitting the sentence makes it unambiguous that the axis is what nobody can see, and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.blok: Die Aarde draai om sy as
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses with their own subject and verb (''n draai heet' / 'ons se').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Required AWS comma; nothing else changes.

toegepas.blok: Die Aarde draai om sy as
toegepas.rede_vinder: The word 'dag' is mentioned as a word here, so it should be marked with quotation marks like the phrase before it.
toegepas.fout: The word 'dag' is mentioned as a word but not marked, so a reader can stumble on 'beteken dag'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Quotation marks match the quoted phrase just before it and make the sentence easier to read on first pass.

toegepas.voor: wat na hom kyk en daar is dit dag

toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses that each have their own subject and verb ('is dit oggend' / 'lyk dit').

toegepas.voor: draai jou plek van die Son af weg en dit word aand
toegepas.na: draai jou plek van die Son weg, en dit word aand
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'van die Son af weg' doubles the direction; the separable verb 'wegdraai van' takes 'van die Son weg', and the AWS comma joins the two clauses.
toegepas.fout: 'van die Son af weg' doubles the direction, and the AWS comma before 'en dit word aand' is missing.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'van die Son weg' is the clean form of the separable verb and the comma is required; same action, same order.

toegepas.voor: By jou middag is dit nag
toegepas.na: Wanneer dit by jou middag is, is dit nag
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'By jou middag' is unidiomatic Afrikaans; a time clause says naturally that it is midday where you are.
toegepas.fout: 'By jou middag' is a compressed, unidiomatic time phrase.
toegepas.rede_keurder: A time clause says naturally that it is midday where you are, with no change in meaning.

toegepas.rede_vinder: The idiomatic construction is 'al agt die planete', with the article after the number.
toegepas.fout: 'Al agt planete' lacks the article Afrikaans uses in this construction.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Al agt die planete' is the natural idiom; the count and scope stay the same.

toegepas.na: 365¼ dae, en ons noem daardie tyd

toegepas.rede_keurder: Required AWS comma; the protected 'ongeveer 365¼ dae' stays intact.

toegepas.voor: roteer en wentel dus op dieselfde tyd
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'op dieselfde tyd' calques 'at the same time'; Afrikaans says 'terselfdertyd' for two things happening simultaneously.
toegepas.fout: 'op dieselfde tyd' is a calque of 'at the same time'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'terselfdertyd' is the natural Afrikaans word for simultaneity and the meaning is identical.

toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses that each have their own subject and verb ('draai die Aarde' / 'reis dit').

toegepas.blok: Wys rotasie met 'n lamp en 'n bal
toegepas.voor: Neem 'n lamp vir die Son en 'n bal vir die Aarde
toegepas.na: Gebruik 'n lamp as die Son en 'n bal as die Aarde
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'vir die Son' calques 'for the Sun'; standing in for something is expressed with 'as' in Afrikaans.
toegepas.fout: 'Neem ... vir die Son' copies English 'for the Sun'; standing in for something takes 'as'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: In both versions the lamp represents the Sun and the ball the Earth, so the preposition fix keeps the meaning and reads naturally.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'alleen genoeg' reads awkwardly and 'alleen' can be misread as 'lonely'; 'op sy eie' says plainly that the turning by itself is enough.

toegepas.rede_keurder: 'op sy eie genoeg' says plainly that the turning by itself suffices, which is what the original means.
